title: DotMM importer room file (JSON form)
description: Same content as the Markdown room file (docs/CONTENT_FORMAT.md). The importer is lenient: unknown fields are ignored, strings are accepted where numbers are expected, and problems are reported rather than fatal.

maps.description: Top-left corner of each map in the combined scene, in grid cells. Keys are map file names without extension, or map letters.

id.description: Unique id. Defaults to the label.

label.description: What the map label shows, e.g. "7" or "12b". Defaults to id.

map.description: Map the position is relative to (file name or letter). Without it, `at` is in whole-scene coordinates.

at.description: Position in grid cells. Omit to import the room unplaced.

oneOf.description: Same as a Markdown monster line, e.g. "3 Skeleton — note".

size.description: Token size in cells, or tiny/small/medium/large/huge/gargantuan.

pair.description: id of the room at the other end.
